title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Riverside Orthopedic Associates under your health plan for services provided on September 3, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.

Reason for denial: The arthroscopic knee meniscectomy is not medically necessary. Our clinical guideline BRI-CAR-340 requires documentation of conservative treatment before this service, and the records submitted do not show it. Reason code: CO-50.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $8,596.35 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $8,596.35.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Brightmoor Benefit Solutions, Appeals Unit, PO Box 4658, Fresno, CA 93721. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-1235.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
